title: Kehti Hai Yahi Sughra Be Qarar Hoon Baba
body:
Kehti hai yahi sughra be qarar hoon baba
Muztarib hai dil mera be qarar hoon baba
1. Tum gaye ho jis din se raah tak rahi hoon
Mein kab talak rahoo tanha be qarar hoon baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haal kiya hai akber ka kuch khabar na mil paee aur na koi khat aaya be qarar hoon baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mere bhai akber ki kab rachaoge shaadi
Kab dekhaoge sehra be qarar hoon baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Rouz o shab nighahoon mein phir raha hai sughra ke
Phool sa hasee'n chera be qarar hoon baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tashnagi ke sehra mein dhoop ki azziyat hai
Koun kitna hai pyaasa be qarar hoon baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khair se watan yarab qafila palat aaye
Qasd hai yahi mera be qarar hoon baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Yaad mein Sakina ki dil tadap ta rehta hai
Jaane kaisi hai dukhiya be qarar hoon baba
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aye sohail hootoun par dil figaar sugra ke
Raat din yeh nouha tha be qarar hoon baba
Azz... Raza Ali sohail
